name: linkedin-parser-tracker
description: LinkedIn Job Vacancy Parser & Kanban Board Tracker with AI Summarization

scripts.check:python: ./.venv/bin/python -m py_compile backend/models.py backend/database.py backend/schemas.py backend/auth.py backend/scraper.py backend/llm.py backend/queue_manager.py backend/main.py backend/location_parser.py backend/parsers/types.py backend/parsers/helpers.py backend/parsers/registry.py backend/parsers/linkedin.py backend/parsers/upwork.py backend/parsers/universal.py backend/parsers/avito.py backend/parsers/habr.py backend/parsers/fl_ru.py backend/parsers/geekjob.py backend/parsers/glassdoor.py backend/parsers/layboard.py backend/parsers/rabota_ru.py backend/parsers/superjob.py
scripts.check:parsers: PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/python -c "from backend.parsers import registry; registry._auto_discover(); [print(f'[{p.priority:+d}] {p.name} needs_extension={p.needs_extension}') for p in registry.all_parsers]; print('OK')"
scripts.check:pg:dbs: psql -U dkoldaev -h localhost -l || psql -U postgres -h localhost -l || psql -l
scripts.redis:start: docker run -d --name redis -p 6379:6379 --restart unless-stopped redis:7-alpine || docker start redis
scripts.redis:ping: docker exec redis redis-cli ping || nc -zv localhost 6379
scripts.check:pg:vacancies: psql -U dkoldaev -h localhost -d linkedin_tracker -c 'SELECT id, job_id, title, company, location, status, tags, created_at FROM vacancies ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5;'
scripts.check:pg:locations: psql -U dkoldaev -h localhost -d linkedin_tracker -c 'SELECT id, title, company, location, city, country FROM vacancies;'
scripts.check:pg:vacancy:detail: psql -U dkoldaev -h localhost -d linkedin_tracker -c 'SELECT id, title, company, location, tech_stack, ai_summary FROM vacancies WHERE id = 3;'
scripts.pg:create:db: psql -U dkoldaev -h localhost -c 'CREATE DATABASE linkedin_tracker;' || psql -U postgres -h localhost -c 'CREATE DATABASE linkedin_tracker;'
scripts.test:pg:docker:conn: docker run --rm python:3.11-slim sh -c 'pip install psycopg2-binary sqlalchemy && python3 -c "from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text; e = create_engine(\"postgresql://dkoldaev@host.docker.internal:5432/linkedin_tracker\"); print(e.connect().execute(text(\"SELECT count(*) FROM vacancies;\")).fetchone())"'
scripts.pg:migrate:locations: psql -U dkoldaev -h localhost -d linkedin_tracker -c 'ALTER TABLE vacancies ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS city VARCHAR(128);' && PYTHONPATH=. DATABASE_URL='postgresql://dkoldaev@localhost:5432/linkedin_tracker' ./.venv/bin/python -c 'from backend.main import backfill_missing_locations; backfill_missing_locations(); print("Postgres locations backfilled!")'
scripts.test:curl: curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/health && echo '' && curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/vacancies | python3 -m json.tool | grep -E '"id"|"title"|"company"' | head -n 12 && curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/tags
scripts.test:crud: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/vacancies -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Docker Postgres Engineer","company":"Test Corp","url":"https://linkedin.com/jobs/view/99999","tags":["docker","postgres-live"]}' | python3 -m json.tool && echo '---' && curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/vacancies | python3 -m json.tool | grep -E '"title"'
scripts.check:api:filters: curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/countries && echo '' && curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/cities && echo '' && curl -s 'http://localhost:8000/api/vacancies?city=Barcelona' | python3 -c 'import sys, json; vs=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f"Found {len(vs)} in Barcelona: {[v["title"] for v in vs]}")'
scripts.check:last:vacancy: curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/vacancies | python3 -c 'import sys, json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(data[0], indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) if data else "No vacancies")'
scripts.check:api:auth: curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/auth/config | python3 -m json.tool && echo '' && curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/auth/me | python3 -m json.tool
scripts.check:api:dev-login: curl -c /tmp/cookies.txt -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/auth/dev-login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"test@example.com","name":"Test User"}' | python3 -m json.tool && echo '' && curl -b /tmp/cookies.txt -s http://localhost:8000/api/auth/me | python3 -m json.tool && echo '' && curl -b /tmp/cookies.txt -s http://localhost:8000/api/vacancies | python3 -m json.tool && rm -f /tmp/cookies.txt
scripts.check:api:isolation: curl -c /tmp/cookies_b.txt -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/auth/dev-login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"user_b@example.com","name":"User B"}' | python3 -m json.tool && echo '--- USER B VACANCIES ---' && curl -b /tmp/cookies_b.txt -s http://localhost:8000/api/vacancies | python3 -m json.tool && rm -f /tmp/cookies_b.txt
scripts.test:all: npm run check:python && npm run test:auth && npm run test:localization && npm run test:workplace && npm run test:salary && npm run test:closed && npm run test:locations && npm run test:history && npm run test:backend && npm run frontend:build
scripts.commit:url:fix: git add backend/auth.py tests/test_auth_and_isolation.py package.json && git commit -m 'fix: use urllib.parse.urlencode to prevent malformed Google OAuth redirect URL'
scripts.commit:oauth:fix: git add backend/auth.py backend/main.py frontend/src/i18n/translations.js package.json && git commit -m 'fix: dynamic oauth env resolution and clear warning message for missing client secret'
scripts.commit:auth: git add backend/ frontend/ tests/ .env.example docker-compose.yml package.json && git commit -m 'feat: multi-user architecture with Google OAuth and isolated boards'
scripts.commit:localization: git add backend/ frontend/ tests/ package.json && git commit -m 'feat: add UI and LLM localization with Mercure constant events'
scripts.commit:salary: git add backend/database.py backend/llm.py backend/main.py backend/models.py backend/queue_manager.py backend/schemas.py backend/scraper.py frontend/src/utils/salary.js frontend/src/components/KanbanCard.jsx frontend/src/components/VacancyModal.jsx frontend/src/index.css tests/test_salary.py tests/test_integration.py package.json && git commit -m 'feat: extract and calculate monthly salary on vacancy cards'
scripts.commit:workplace: git add backend/database.py backend/llm.py backend/main.py backend/models.py backend/queue_manager.py backend/schemas.py backend/scraper.py frontend/src/App.jsx frontend/src/components/KanbanCard.jsx frontend/src/components/VacancyModal.jsx frontend/src/utils/workplace.js frontend/src/index.css tests/test_workplace.py package.json && git commit -m 'feat: add workplace type (remote, hybrid, on-site) and filter'
scripts.commit:closed: git add backend/database.py backend/main.py backend/models.py backend/queue_manager.py backend/schemas.py backend/scraper.py frontend/src/components/KanbanCard.jsx frontend/src/components/VacancyModal.jsx frontend/src/index.css tests/test_closed.py package.json && git commit -m 'feat: add closed vacancy status parsing and card design'
scripts.commit:parsers: git add -A && git commit -m 'feat: modular multi-site vacancy parsers, types, and extension e2e integration'
scripts.git:commit:push: npm run commit:parsers && npm run git:push
